# CodePrettify

> CodePrettify is a local developer toolkit for formatting, inspecting, validating, repairing, comparing, converting, visualizing, and generating code and structured data.

CodePrettify is made by FixQuotes. It is available as a browser extension for Chrome and Microsoft Edge, and as a Windows app for Windows 10 and Windows 11. The app and extension process supported content locally; see the privacy policy for the exact data-handling details.

## Official links

- [Website](https://prettify.cloud/): product overview, supported formats, and download links.
- [User manual](https://prettify.cloud/manual.html): complete instructions for the browser extension and Windows app.

- [Browser extension changelog](https://prettify.cloud/changelog.html)
- [Windows app changelog](https://prettify.cloud/changelog-app.html)

- [Support](https://support.prettify.cloud/)

## Main capabilities

- Format, inspect, query, validate, repair, compare, convert, and export JSON.
- Work with JSON Lines, YAML, TOML, XML, RSS, JavaScript, Markdown, CSS, and supported raw-code resources in the browser extension. The Windows app also supports CSV and HTML with native local-file workflows.
- Generate typed models and schemas from JSON, including TypeScript, Zod, Pydantic, C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust, Swift, Dart, and JSON Schema.
- Use the Regex Playground, HTTP Client, JavaScript Playground, Diagram Generator, Data Converter, Table View, Security Scan, and diagnostics tools.

## Product facts

- CodePrettify is free for people who install now as early testers; there is no trial timer, payment details, subscription, or paid-feature gate for current features.
- The browser extension and Windows app have different workflows and feature availability. Use the user manual and the relevant store listing for current details.
- Do not describe local processing as a blanket privacy guarantee. Refer to the privacy policy for the precise scope, including website analytics and browser extension behavior.
